rel_notes.n:
- Set, remove and import the secret manager of applications, services and databases, key names are listed and values are never returned
- Bump the SQLite image to `3.54.1-v0.2.0` with SQLite 3.54.1, which lets any user ID write the database files, so a connected application no longer has to run as `65532` or root
- Replace the user ID note on the connect page with a warning that a bind mount opens the database files to every user on the host
- Keep the file names of PostgreSQL init scripts inside the init s
- Fixed MCP tokens with the `read:sensitive` permission, which did not see the commands and configuration of applications and databases.

- Improved MySQL and MariaDB restores. They use the restore options of newer client versions, check the backup before they change the database, and stop with a clear message for unsupported content (#12352).
- Custom database configuration and custom Docker options of standalone databases are now shown only to team admins and owners, and to API tokens with sensitive read access (#12353).
* fix(database-import): improve MySQL and MariaDB restore handling by @andrasbacsai in https://github.com/coollabsio/cool

- Saved removed databases in the backup list (#11548) and explained dumps that stopped without an error (#11549).
- Fixed the database image picker (#12337) and server IDs in the new resource wizard (#12327).
- Security: blocked PostgreSQL restore scan bypasses and stopped restores on SQL errors (#12333).
- Security: hid database URLs in API create responses without sensitive access (#12297, fixes #11190).
- Security: scoped database backup API endpoints to the database type (#12279).
- Kept privileges in P

- Added a file browser for applications, services, and databases (#11518, fixes #6519)
- Added an automatic backup of the Coolify database before an update (#12093)
- Added a cache flush for Redis, KeyDB, and Dragonfly databases (#11513)
- PostgreSQL healthchecks and backups set `PGPASSWORD` (#12224, fixes #6353)
- Backups use the configured databases when the container environment is missing (#12212, fixes #9417)
- Database updates apply `redis_password` and `instant_deploy`
- Database custom configuration
